title: Super Fast Slides and Moving Escalators
content: The airport for me has been relatively straightforward. I can get there via the mall or a tram. However, the last several times I’ve been to the airport I’ve had to navigate crazy escalators and moving walkways. Imagine the staircases in Harry Potter. The newest addition I’ve experienced maybe 5 times now are what I can best describe as hyper speed enclosed slides. I don’t really remember getting in but it was small, claustrophobic and moving so fast I felt uneasy. It was dark and grey, with some small lights along the bottom. I could feel it twisting and climbing and dropping and then I popped out in another area of the airport. Anyone else?
